newsitem.title: UK: European bunker fuels steady at the lower levels.
newsitem.headline: European bunker fuels steady at the lower levels.

text.p: European bunker fuel prices were holding steady at the lower levels on Friday after sharp falls this week.
Brokers said aggressive selling in most regions against falling spot fuel oil prices as well as weakening crude and gas oil futures had subsided with the recent downtrend keeping buyers relaxed.

"There was some strong competition for business earlier in the week as sellers chased buyers, but demand has thinned sharply again sellers are more reluctant to offer into the resulting void", a broker said.
Prices for fuel oils continued to hold a softer undertone as the spot market remained under pressure but diesels and gas oil steadied in line with stronger crude and gas oil futures.

In the ARA-Hamburg range offers for high and low sulphur fuels were slightly softer but bids were mostly stable around Thursdays late levels despite a fall off in demand. 380 cst bunkers in Rotterdam valued around $119 with 180 cst talked $125. Prices in Hamburg were around $6 above these levels with diesel and gas oil up around $2.
